processing_gaps.reason: The explicit context-key operands acquire interface selection and public arguments. Omission remains undefined, including the eighteenth limit output. Acquisition does not require every key for every capability. EM01 preserves a possible invocation container without treating all its members as task requirements; no source-level invocation reader or additional runtime acquisition is invented.

The setup command executes only after successful cd. The supplied package metadata does not implement npm installation, package extraction, installation scripts or package-manager transport. Those internal effects remain unresolved; the install status is a separate actual tool result. ESM, Node >=18 and TypeScript configuration do not invoke analysis.

dotenv.config executes on actual settings-module evaluation against current cwd. Its implementation is absent, so the exact .env content read, diagnostics and environment changes are not expanded. The post-environment is distinct from its prestate. Client initialization belongs exclusively to ir_014, and settings are reread on subsequent getSettings calls.

Internal getter calls at this and other summary coordinates preserve their real zero-argument boundaries and actual returned handles. Their conditional cache creation and credential acquisition are not expanded at those caller coordinates by the local call declaration. Independently selected getter semantics do not substitute for those unresolved caller state effects. The unresolved scope is the relevant cache and constructor provenance, not the supported report request, response, save-data version or result binding. Existing handles retain creation-time credentials; current property/site and saving settings are separate reads. This is a scoped limitation of the modeled call-boundary summary, not replacement coverage for the instruction.

The source-supported persistent payload writes are retained at each save summary coordinate, using the actual response, projected data, constructed result or completed aggregate. The compact summaries do not expand their category-directory existence check, conditional recursive mkdir, selected path construction and failure ordering. Those filesystem-control relationships remain unresolved at each summarized save coordinate; a successful write is conditional on their success. Their symbolic storage location is not a definite alias of another invocation's file. ir_309 through ir_317 separately expand the direct saveResult entry and do not supply caller-coordinate execution. Filename time and savedAt remain distinct observations, and no write acquires unread file contents. This scoped limitation does not replace the instruction's modeled boundary and payload relations.

Summary request and serialization computations are local opaque calculations, not evidence of unchanged field forwarding. GA4 requests require dateRanges to contain the parsed range as one array element; ir_026's intermediate dateRanges member is insufficient to establish that array representation until its request computation. Every report summary must map dimension and metric names to named objects and omit filters/orderBy. Summary extra calculations must select the original public date only when it is a string, otherwise undefined; aggregate and bulk extras instead use custom for nonstrings. Operation and extra remain separate operands. The computations retain those source meanings, while exact output structure remains a precision limitation.

Each loop occurrence has its own child acquisition and actual normal or thrown alternative. Publication uses that occurrence's original URL and URL_UPDATED. The constructed notification uses response metadata URL or the original URL; only a falsy latestUpdate notification time acquires a fallback clock. The success projection's later spread may replace its original URL. A post-submission failure may occur before a normal response or during response processing; the retained delivery alone does not identify a successful response. The summary does not separately retain every such received-response-before-error version.

The append summary preserves normal collection contribution and actual exceptions but does not identify the exact partial mutation when a protected push itself throws. Catch-body logging, String(error) and the failure push can also throw outside the try. Such failure prevents the following backedge, final save and return; earlier request and cache effects are not rolled back.

The member-specific inspection response is acquired separately from the URL request. Its opaque constructed-result computation must retain the source projection: inspection link, indexStatus with NEUTRAL/Unknown fallbacks and optional index fields, mobileUsability only for a truthy mobile section, and richResults only for a truthy rich section. Those conditional sections are not expanded at this caller coordinate. The independently selected inspectUrl branches do not provide caller-coordinate branch execution. Only returned.indexStatus is retained by checkIndexStatus; reading the whole child return does not make mobile or rich-result fields task requirements.

The explicit loop summaries retain source occurrence identity, order and duplicates through member, predecessor merge and append. Normal checkIndexStatus rows preserve the original URL, compare verdict strictly with PASS and retain only indexStatus; caught failures append indexed:false and status.error from the actual caught exception. Empty input executes no member acquisition. requestIndexingBatch has no per-member catch, so a complete collection and optional final save exist only on normal traversal. The summaries do not infer a singleton iteration, precise cache-hit count or unconditional cache overwrite.

The explicit request build keeps actual property, parsed date, named dimensions and metrics, plus the original limit only under a Boolean truthiness calculation. filters and orderBy are absent. A getSettings whole returned internally is not itself a request payload; property/site helpers return their selected values. Credential plaintext is not added to analytics, realtime, metadata, Search Console or inspection requests merely because settings were internally read.

The reference describes top pages by impressions, while the Skill and index describe clicks. The actual Search Console query supplies no ordering, so neither description receives executable precedence. keywordAnalysis collects an independent device aggregate, and seoPagePerformance an independent country aggregate; no query-by-device or page-by-country join is implemented.

Date helper calls at summary coordinates retain actual argument and returned parsed-date boundaries, but their conditional settings reads and concrete-date clock acquisitions are not individually expanded there. Falsy input reads the current default; effective objects pass through unchanged; matching Nd strings parse base-10 days; other strings use 30. GA4 and private bulk parsing produce relative endpoints. Search Console uses separate end/start clock values, local-calendar subtraction and ISO date portions. Explicit relative endpoint objects are not converted.

The saved JSON wrapper and its UTF-8 representation are distinct from the original returned data. JSON.stringify can omit undefined object properties; undefined is not silently changed into JSON null. Serialization or writing may throw. The write replaces the selected path and has no public file-content output. A second-precision timestamp and sanitized operation/extra do not supply a unique invocation identity. Metadata uses current propertyId and omits Search Console site identity.

A successful load reads the whole chosen UTF-8 file and returns actual parsed content without runtime wrapper validation. Absence and caught read/parse failure return null; existsSync is outside that catch. Under EM02-EM04, an agent continuation returning the parsed value for natural-language processing can expose that returned version to the model. This code establishes local processing but supplies no concrete tool-to-model routing, model request or user delivery; local returns:[] must not be interpreted as a verified guarantee about an unspecified external continuation. Neither reading a whole value nor possible model observation makes every field necessary.

The first selected candidate is an independent file acquisition. listResults reads directory names, keeps .json suffixes, joins paths and sorts using the source's split('/').pop() comparator, without substituting modification time or a platform-specific improvement. limit applies only when not undefined. getLatestResult filters a sanitized substring in the path rather than validating operation metadata; it reads only the first candidate and does not skip an unreadable first candidate. Names, labels, timestamps, metadata and a saved-result continuation do not establish provenance from a preceding analysis invocation.

The Skill requires analysis, automatic JSON saving, reading saved JSON and a Markdown summary in results/summaries with tables, trends and recommendations. No supplied implementation connects a returned analysis to its selected saved file or implements the summary consumer and Markdown write. These missing relationships remain obligations and diagnostics, not executable edges. Optional saves, comparison child save:false and the empty bulk early return do not override the Skill.

Successful construction creates a distinct credential-derived handle, not credential plaintext. Validation and construction use separate current-settings reads. Cached returns bypass validation and retain creation-time credentials. Source code assigns the chosen binding after successful construction; the finite summary uses a possible named state update without claiming exact cache creation counts. Dependency implementations are absent, so authentication transport, internal credential retention, retries and backend persistence remain unresolved.

Each settings read uses current process.env and cwd: missing identifiers/credentials become empty strings, escaped private-key newlines are replaced, the default range is 30d and resultsDir is cwd/results. This differs from the Skill's project-root .env placement unless cwd is that root. Validation checks property ID, email and private key in order, including for Search Console/indexing, but not siteUrl. Internal whole settings/environment scope does not establish model observation or network delivery of every field.

Interface routing selects one independent capability. Index module evaluation only prints literal help under its guard; exports and examples invoke no analysis. Package ranges and locked resolutions are distinct: analytics ^4.9.0/4.12.1, indexing and searchconsole ^6.0.1/6.0.1, dotenv ^16.4.7/16.6.1, googleapis ^170.0.0/170.1.0, tsx ^4.19.2/4.21.0 and TypeScript ^5.7.2/5.9.3. Their presence does not establish dependency behavior. Unknown API content, memberships and clock values are precision limits. Outside the displayed catches, failures terminate the invocation exceptionally while earlier requests, assignments and files can remain.
